newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Liaoning-based Polyether Co plans B share offer.
newsitem.headline: Liaoning-based Polyether Co plans B share offer.

text.p: Liaoning-based Polyether Co Ltd plans to issue 135 million B shares in 1997, a company official said on Thursday.
The company, a unit of China's giant Jinxi Chemical General Plant, is among the 33 enterprises selected by the Securities Commission of the State Council as candidates for B share listings.

The official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that firm had not yet decided where it would apply to list the B shares. The timing and pricing of the offer has not been set.

If the offer goes through, the firm plans to use the proceeds to build a plant capable of producing 80,000 tonnes of polyether a year, the official said. After the issue, the company would have 283 million shares, consisting of 148 million legal person shares and 135 million B shares, he said.

The firm, based in the city of Huludao in northeastern Liaoning province, estimates its 1996 net earnings at 76 million yuan versus 51 million yuan in 1995 and 23 million yuan a year earlier, the official said. He said the company also has plans to apply for an offer of 100 million class A shares but he did not give details.
